notes: Sync in about a second, and it can no longer fail in silence. The cloud now tells this device the moment the other side saves (instant channel), your own changes go up 0.6 s after you make them, and without the instant channel the app checks every single second. If this device is signed out, refused or cannot reach the cloud, the top bar says so in red and Cloud Sync explains it — until now it kept saying “Live sync” while nothing had synced for days.
